newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk tender for Conrail oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk tender for Conrail oversubscribed.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said Wednesday it had completed its tender offer for 9.9 percent of Conrail Inc and the $115-a-share offer was oversubscribed.
The preliminary proration factor under the offer is 12.26 percent, it said.
The final proration factor is expected to be announced by February 11, it said.
Based on a preliminary count, about 66.8 million Conrail shares were tendered, including about 24.1 million subject to guarantees of delivery, it said.
Norfolk said its subsidiary, Atlantic Acquisition Corp, accepted for payment 8.2 million shares, representing about 9.9 percent of the outstanding common shares of Conrail.
The 9.9 percent is the maximum Norfolk can buy without triggering Conrail's "poison pill," it said.
Conrail has agreed to merge with CSX Corp. Norfolk Southern has made a competing bid for Conrail.
Last month Conrail shareholders defeated a key provision that would have permitted the CSX deal to move forward.
